Good questions

About reserving.

Anything else? Write to team@ducksnpuddles.com and a real person will answer.

What is the $1 reservation?

It’s a small deposit that holds your spot before our Kickstarter campaign goes live. It tells us you’re in — and it unlocks a few things only reservers get, including a private link to a secret reward on launch day.

Is it refundable?

We’ll publish the full reservation terms, including refunds, on this page before you pay.

Have I bought a bottle by reserving?

Not yet. The $1 holds your spot and your perks. On launch day you’ll pick your reward and back the campaign on Kickstarter.

What’s the secret reward?

It’s a surprise, and it can only be reached through the private link we email to reservers on launch day.

When does the Kickstarter launch?

Soon. Reservers hear first — we’ll email you the moment it goes live.

Can I reserve more than one duck?

Yes. Choose “All three”, or reserve once for each duck you’d like.

When will my bottle arrive?

Bottles ship after the campaign ends and production is complete. We’ll share a confirmed timeline before launch, and keep reservers updated along the way.
